## Problem

What limitation of the current fixed-fixture ladder or fixed-template WfP example would this address?

## Proposed change

Describe a bounded solution, its expected behavior, and how you would verify it.

## Alternatives and boundaries

Describe alternatives considered. If the request would introduce arbitrary source, public tenant URLs, or a new deployment contract, explain the identity, quota, cleanup, and artifact implications.

## Additional context

Link relevant documentation, tests, or non-sensitive screenshots.
